description: What exactly does this provider support, where is it licensed and what does it charge? Paid ($0.01 USDC): Full cited record for one provider: stablecoin rails, corridors, licences, published fees, coverage, developer and agent-payment support. Every fact has source URL, retrieval date, quote and confidence. This server holds no wallet and never pays: it returns the HTTP 402 payment requirements (x402 on Base, MPP on Tempo) and the URL https://payments-intel-production.up.railway.app/v1/provider. Pay with your own x402/MPP client and retry that URL. Paid: $0.01 per call (x402/MPP).
